high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by Kendall Jenner. The post shows Kendall Jenner sitting on a wooden stool next to a small wooden table. She is wearing a navy blue baseball cap with a small red logo on the front, a black long-sleeve sweater, a red skirt, white socks, and black loafers. Kendall is holding an open book or magazine in her hands, seemingly reading it. On the table beside her, there is a can of what appears to be a beverage. The background is minimalistic, featuring a plain white wall and a light-colored floor, giving the scene a clean and simple aesthetic
